name: TREADING
description: Careful movement through uncertain ground; conduct that tests each step

name: GRACE
description: Effortless beauty of form; refinement that does not strain

name: INNOCENCE
description: The state before categories harden; pre-knowledge openness

name: PROGRESS
description: Forward movement toward a goal; gradual advance

name: DELIVERANCE
description: Release from danger or bondage; the storm breaks and the way clears

name: OPPRESSION
description: Weight imposed from above; exhaustion under unjust constraint

name: REVOLUTION
description: Radical overturning of the old form; the skin shed when the season demands

name: CAULDRON
description: The vessel of transformation; what you cook matters more than the fire

name: WANDERER
description: One who passes through without settling; the outsider who sees clearly

name: LIMITATION
description: Necessary restriction that gives form; the bank that shapes the river

name: BITING
description: Cutting through obstruction by force; the jaw that closes on what blocks the way

name: ABYSMAL
description: The deep water that must be crossed; danger that teaches through immersion
